import json

def get_location(wonder):
    api_key = "YOUR_API_KEY"
    base_url = f"https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?address={wonder}&key={api_key}"
    response = requests.get(base_url)
    data = json.loads(response.text)
    return data["results"][0]["geometry"]["location"]

# YouTube Data API
def get_video(wonder):
    api_key = "YOUR_API_KEY"
    base_url = f"https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/search?part=snippet&q={wonder}&type=video&key={api_key}"
    response = requests.get(base_url)
    data = json.loads(response.text)
    return data["items"][0]["id"]["videoId"]

# Create a dictionary of wonders with their locations and video IDs
wonders = {
    "The Great Wall of China": get_location("The Great Wall of China"),
    "The Taj Mahal": get_location("The Taj Mahal"),
    "Machu Picchu": get_location("Machu Picchu"),

    "The Christ the Redeemer statue": get_location("The Christ the Redeemer statue"),

}

    "Machu Picchu": get_video("Machu Picchu"),

}
